extensionDescription.message: Unlock your local Keyward vault and fill a matching login when you click. Requires the local Keyward service.

noMatches.message: No saved logins match this exact website. Add or edit its website in the web vault.

filled.message: Login filled. Submit the form when you are ready.

clipboardNotice.message: Clipboard copies are not automatically cleared.

localNotice.message: Start Keyward on this computer. Only 127.0.0.1 is supported.

sessionNotice.message: Closing this popup locks the vault. Fill only websites you trust.

sessionExpired.message: Vault locked after five minutes of inactivity.

invalidPort.message: Enter a local service port from 1 to 65535.

invalidLength.message: Choose a password length from 8 to 128.

clipboardBlocked.message: The browser could not copy the password.

serverUnavailable.message: Cannot connect to Keyward. Start the local service and check its port.

serverReadFailed.message: Keyward could not read the vault. Check the service and vault file before trying again.

connectionTimedOut.message: The local connection timed out. Check the service and try again.

invalidResponse.message: The local service did not return a Keyward vault.

noVault.message: No vault exists yet. Use Manage vault to create one.

unlockFailed.message: Could not unlock: the master password is wrong or the vault is damaged or unsupported.

invalidVault.message: The decrypted vault has an unsupported structure.

sessionCancelled.message: The vault is locked. Unlock again to continue.

accountUnavailable.message: This login is unavailable for the current website.

pageChanged.message: The page changed. Reopen the extension on the intended website.

unsupportedSite.message: Use an HTTPS website or an HTTP loopback address.

noLoginForm.message: No visible login password field was found. Iframes and signup forms are not supported.

ambiguousForm.message: Multiple login password fields were found. Keyward cannot safely choose a form.

ambiguousUsername.message: Keyward could not identify a unique username field in the login form.

unsafeForm.message: The form changed or sends data to a different website. Nothing further was filled.

fillFailed.message: Could not fill this page. Restricted pages and some form layouts are unsupported.
